## Executive education and faculty development

I design and deliver management and faculty development programmes on applied research methods, evidence-based policy analysis, causal inference, discrete choice experiments, survey design and data analytics.

::: {.entry}
[Capacity Development Programme for Indian Universities, Rapid Round III]{.entry-head}

[Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO), NITI Aayog. Coordinator, October 2025 to April 2026.]{.entry-sub}
:::

::: {.entry}
[Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programmes (Advanced MDP, EAP and MDP)]{.entry-head}

[Ministry of MSME, Government of India. Co-Coordinator, July 2025 to March 2026.]{.entry-sub}
:::

::: {.entry}
[Research Methodology and Applied R]{.entry-head}

[Four-session faculty development programme, Amity University Patna, with hands-on R worksheets.]{.entry-sub}
:::

## Research assistants and interns

I take on undergraduate interns and research assistants on my projects. Assignments are open-ended by design: you get a real question and a messy dataset, and the work is judged on the choices you make with it.
